lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the midsection, with slightly tighter compression on the anterior shoulder region and increased spacing toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several posterior line segments terminate approximately 60% of the way down the torso mass, failing to reach the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A single horizontal cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lateral posterior haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Four of the five spots on the haunch are aligned in a near-perfect horizontal geometric line.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Dual-spiral lyrate curvature. Vectors initiate with a lateral flare from the frontal bone, followed by a medial convergence and a final dorsal-vertical tip orientation.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 1.75 times the width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 12-15% of the total visible horn length from base to apex.

other_distinctive_markers: A single avian organism (Oxpecker) is perched on the dorsal ridge at the mid-torso point. Two distinct white spots are visible on the lateral face below the eye, and a white chevron is visible on the bridge of the snout.
